findings.title: /admin dashboard data is served to unauthenticated guests
findings.details: Loading /admin without a session renders the full dashboard — all four KPI stat cards (50 / 500 / 201 / $1,233,808.23), the Orders-by-status Chart.js chart, the 8-item notifications feed and the 7-row recent-orders table — with a guest header ('Sign in'). No redirect to /auth/login and no data masking. The admin dashboard is an admin-only surface in name only.
findings.recommendation: Gate /admin behind the authenticated route; redirect guests to /auth/login (or render an anonymous placeholder) so admin KPIs and order data are not exposed pre-login.

findings.title: Orders-by-status chart is a static canvas with no accessible tooltip
findings.details: The Chart.js bar chart renders at canvas#chart-bar (data-testid=chart-bar) but hovering bars produces no tooltip DOM node and no accessible fallback (no aria-label on the canvas). Chart data is not exposed to assistive tech or observable via hover.
findings.recommendation: Add an aria-label/summary describing the chart, or render a data table fallback for the orders-by-status breakdown.
